lines.en: label mikudorm45p2:
scene mikuwalksatnight1
Eventually, we do stop talking about my penis.
lines.zh: 最后我们总算不再聊我的阴茎了。

lines.en: Depressing, I know.
lines.zh: 我知道，挺扫兴的。

lines.en: But seeing as it’s dangerous enough to discuss that in the dorms, it would be even more dangerous to walk the streets of Kumon-mi without trying to move onto other topics.
lines.zh: 不过既然在宿舍里聊这个都够危险了，那要在 Kumon-mi 的街头上一边走一边还聊这个，就更危险了，还是换点别的话题吧。

lines.en: Things that will not ultimately serve as yet another common ground for the two of these girls to sprawl out on.
lines.zh: 换些不会最终变成这两个女孩又一块“摊开”的共同话题。

lines.en: I guess one of them hasn’t done much sprawling yet, though.
lines.zh: 不过其中一个大概还没怎么“摊开”过。

lines.en: But it’s only a matter of time- and I’m sure Makoto knows that too.
lines.zh: 但这只是时间问题——我敢肯定 Makoto 也清楚这一点。

lines.en: Miku’s grown up in a world filled with competition- she lives for it. And not just to win either.
lines.zh: Miku 是在一个充满竞争的世界里长大的——她为竞争而生。而且还不只是为了赢。

lines.en: There are a lot of people out there who will tell you the whole idea of playing sports is to have fun, and there are those who would vehemently disagree.
lines.zh: 很多人会告诉你，运动的全部意义在于开心；也有不少人会激烈地反对。

lines.en: I’d probably be one of those people.
lines.zh: 我大概属于后者。

lines.en: And I’m sure that in the right shade of light, Miku would be too.
lines.zh: 而且我敢肯定，在某个恰当的角度下，Miku 也会是。

lines.en: But I think this is just one of those times where she’s excited to be playing.
lines.zh: 不过我觉得，现在只是那种“她光是能上场就很兴奋”的时刻。

lines.en: Especially since it’s a game she’s just learning to play now.
lines.zh: 尤其是这还是一场她刚刚学着去玩的游戏。

lines.en: But maybe her best friend will be able to help her.
lines.zh: 不过也许她最好的朋友能帮上她。

lines.en: And maybe one day, I can have them both sprawled out over that common ground at once.
lines.zh: 也许有一天，我能让她们俩同时摊在那片共同的土地上。

lines.en: : Oh, Makoto. What’d ya wind up doin’ with that fancy painting Touka gave ya?
lines.zh: : 哦，Makoto。Touka 送你的那幅高级画，你最后怎么处理了？

lines.en: : I wound up giving it to my mother to either hang up at home or sell but, knowing her, I doubt she still has it.
lines.zh: : 我最后把它给了我妈，让她挂在家里或者卖掉，不过以她的性子，我怀疑她早就没留着了。

lines.en: : Yeah, Maki doesn’t really seem like the kind of girl who would be into stuff like that.
lines.zh: : 是啊，Maki 看着也不像会喜欢那种东西的女孩。

lines.en: : It’s less that she doesn’t care for things like that and more that she’s just really into...one very specific hobby.
lines.zh: : 与其说她不喜欢那种东西，不如说她只……沉迷于某一个非常特定的爱好。

lines.en: : But that’s not really something I want to discuss right now since I’m going to be surrounded by it in a matter of minutes.
lines.zh: : 不过这事我现在真不想讨论，因为再过几分钟我就要被那东西包围了。

lines.en: : I’d much prefer to hear about Sensei’s present.
lines.zh: : 我更想听听 Sensei 的礼物是怎么回事。

lines.en: scene mikuwalksatnight2
: Oh, I’m involved now?
lines.zh: : 哦，现在扯到我了？

lines.en: : Yeah. Didn’t Molly make somethin’ for ya, Sensei? I remember hearin’ somethin’ about that.
lines.zh: : 对啊。Molly 不是给你做了点什么吗，Sensei？我记得听说过这事。

lines.en: : You two talkin’ again? Cause she seemed really beat up for a while over whatever happened with you two.
lines.zh: : 你们俩又和好了？因为她因为你们之间发生的事，看起来消沉了好一阵子。

lines.en: : We’re on good enough terms for her to make me clothing, at least.
lines.zh: : 至少关系好到她愿意给我做衣服了。

lines.en: : Are we finally saying goodbye to your trusty thick t-shirt?
lines.zh: : 我们终于要跟那件忠实相伴的厚 T 恤说再见了？

lines.en: : Well, it’s not like I was going to be able to wear it forever.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我也不可能一辈子都穿它。

lines.en: : Once summer comes, I’ll need something thinner. And I guess Molly just figured that out before I could.
lines.zh: : 等夏天来了，我就得穿薄一点的。大概 Molly 比我先想到了这一点。

lines.en: scene mikuwalksatnight3
: I suppose we’ll get to see it soon then. The weather’s been rather nice these last few days.
lines.zh: : 那我们应该很快就能看到了。最近几天天气一直相当不错。

lines.en: : Fine by me. I’m tired of wearin’ this oversized jacket. Summer Miku’s been rarin’ to go for months.
lines.zh: : 我没意见。我早穿够这件超大号外套了。“夏日版 Miku”已经摩拳擦掌好几个月了。

lines.en: : You wore a hoodie all last summer too, so I was just under the impression you liked being overheated.
lines.zh: : 去年整个夏天你也穿着连帽衫，所以我一直以为你喜欢把自己捂得热乎乎的。

lines.en: scene mikuwalksatnight4
: Nah...it ain’t really like that. I just don’t really change up my look that often and that’s what I had lyin’ around.
lines.zh: : 不……不是那么回事。我只是不怎么换造型，而手边正好就那一件。

lines.en: : But...I’ve been thinkin’ it might be time to maybe try out a few new things and see if any of ‘em stick. You know?
lines.zh: : 不过……我一直在想，也许是时候试试一些新东西，看看有没有能留下来的。你懂吧？

lines.en: : Want me to help with your hair again? I’ve noticed that it’s starting to get longer and I actually quite enjoy doing it when the circumstances aren’t utterly horrible.
lines.zh: : 要我再帮你弄头发吗？我注意到它开始变长了，而且只要场合不是糟糕透顶，我其实还挺喜欢给你弄的。

lines.en: scene mikuwalksatnight5
: Yeah! Just don’t use the scissors to kill me or somethin’. I know how you can be when you get competitive and we are kinda like rivals now.
lines.zh: : 好啊！只是别拿剪刀把我弄死什么的。我知道你一较真起来是什么样，而且我们现在算是对手了嘛。

lines.en: scene mikuwalksatnight6
: I’m not going to murder you, Miku.
lines.zh: : 我不会杀你的，Miku。

lines.en: : Sounds like somethin' a murderer would say.
lines.zh: : 这话听着就像是杀人犯会说的。

lines.en: : God, I really hope this isn’t just how you are now. It’s difficult enough having to use virtually all of my free time teaching you the things Sensei doesn’t.
lines.zh: : 天哪，我真希望这不是你现在固定的样子。光是把我几乎全部的空闲时间都拿来教你 Sensei 不教的那些东西，就已经够费劲了。

lines.en: : Don’t worry, Makoto. I’ll make sure to teach Miku everything I know.
lines.zh: : 别担心，Makoto。我会把我知道的都教给 Miku 的。

lines.en: scene mikuwalksatnight7
: Like hell you will!
lines.zh: : 你想得美！

lines.en: : I think only I’m allowed to joke about stuff like that, Sensei. Makoto’s gonna get mad if you start doin’ it.
lines.zh: : 我觉得那种玩笑只有我能开，Sensei。你要是也开，Makoto 会生气的。

lines.en: : Start?! Our entire relationship is based around him using me however he wants.
lines.zh: : 开始？！我们整段关系的基础，就是他想怎么用我就怎么用我。

lines.en: scene mikuwalksatnight8
: That ain’t true, Makoto. Sensei likes you and doesn’t do that stuff to hurt you on purpose.
lines.zh: : 才不是呢，Makoto。Sensei 喜欢你，他做那些事也不是故意要伤你。

lines.en: : And I ain’t sayin’ I know a lot about all of that adult stuff you and your mom watch together but, from what I’ve heard, it sounds to me like Sensei has done plenty to please you and not just-
lines.zh: : 我也不是说我对你们母女一起看的那些成人玩意儿有多了解，不过就我听说的来看，Sensei 可是做了不少让你舒服的事，而不只是——

lines.en: scene mikuwalksatnight9
: Oh, look! My family’s store! What an inconvenient moment for this conversation to end.
lines.zh: : 哦，瞧！我家的店！这段对话在这儿结束可真不巧。

lines.en: : The porn shop is still like three blocks-
lines.zh: : 那家色情店还隔着三条街呢——

lines.en: scene mikuwalksatnight10
: Right! Which means it’s the perfect place for us to part ways and not further discuss the horrible things we do with and to each other.
lines.zh: : 没错！所以这里正是我们分道扬镳的最佳地点，正好不用继续讨论我们对彼此做的那些可怕的事。

lines.en: : If they’re so horrible, how come you keep-
lines.zh: : 既然那么可怕，那你干嘛还一直——

lines.en: : CAN’T HEAR YOU! HAVE TO WORK! BYE!
lines.zh: : 听不见！我要上班了！再见！

lines.en: scene mikuwalksatnight11
: I think that Makoto probably would have kept a few more secrets from you if she had known you were going to just bring them up in casual conversation.
lines.zh: : 我觉得，要是 Makoto 早知道你会把这些事随口抖出来，她大概还会再多瞒你几个秘密。

lines.en: : I just don’t get why she’s so embarrassed about it.
lines.zh: : 我就是不明白她为什么那么难为情。

lines.en: : I think the easiest way to put it is to just say that Makoto is kind of a different person when she’s doing that kind of stuff.
lines.zh: : 最简单的说法大概就是：Makoto 在做那种事的时候，有点像变了个人。

lines.en: : Different how?
lines.zh: : 怎么个不一样？

lines.en: : Is that a real question? Because that seems like a weird thing to ask about your best friend.
lines.zh: : 你这是认真的吗？问自己闺蜜这种事，听着挺奇怪的。

lines.en: scene mikuwalksatnight12
: Man! I’ve got no idea what’s okay to talk about and what’s not okay to talk about when it comes to this stuff.
lines.zh: : 哎呀！这种事到底什么能聊、什么不能聊，我真是完全没概念。

lines.en: : How come playin’ for two teams is like...twice as hard as playin’ for one?
lines.zh: : 为什么“一脚踩两队”……比只踢一队难上一倍啊？

lines.en: : Miku, I know you’re not very good at math, but I think that you can handle this problem if you just believe in yourself.
lines.zh: : Miku，我知道你数学不太好，不过我觉得只要你相信自己，这道题你算得出来。

lines.en: scene black
Miku and I walk for a little while longer, and I’m pretty sure it’s aimless as well since it’s in a direction I’ve never gone before.
lines.zh: 我和 Miku 又走了一会儿，而且我敢肯定这一路也是漫无目的，因为走的方向我从来没走过。

lines.en: I doubt that either of us care much right now about where we’re headed or what we’re going to do when we get there.
lines.zh: 我怀疑眼下我们俩都不太在意要去哪儿，或者到了之后要做什么。

lines.en: We’re just kind of...moving from one place to the next and hoping that existing beside one another isn’t enough to tire the other out.
lines.zh: 我们只是……从一个地方挪到下一个地方，盼着“彼此的存在”不至于把对方耗到厌倦。

lines.en: With someone like Miku beside me, that much is always a little uncertain.
lines.zh: 身边要是 Miku 这样的人，这一点总是有点悬。

lines.en: But it’s been getting better lately.
lines.zh: 不过最近好转了。

lines.en: Well, maybe “better” isn’t the right word.
lines.zh: 嗯，也许“好转”这个词不太准确。

lines.en: But she doesn’t tire me out even half as much as she used to...and that is absolutely a good thing.
lines.zh: 但她再也没像以前那样让我疲惫，连一半都不到……而这绝对是件好事。

lines.en: On the other side of things, though-
lines.zh: 不过从另一方面来说——

lines.en: It’s clear that she’s the one beginning to get a little exhausted.
lines.zh: 很明显，开始感到有点疲惫的反倒是她。

lines.en: scene mikuwalksatnight13
: Everything okay?
lines.zh: : 一切都还好吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, yeah. Everything’s good. Really good, actually.
lines.zh: : 嗯，嗯。一切都好。其实相当好。

lines.en: : I’m just still tryin’ to wrap my head around everything.
lines.zh: : 我只是还在努力消化这一切。

lines.en: : I’m used to stuff movin’ fast since that’s pretty much all I’ve ever known, but...this is a completely different kinda fast.
lines.zh: : 我习惯了事情进展得快，因为一直以来我经历的都是这样，可是……这次是截然不同的快。

lines.en: : My blood’s pumpin’ and my heart is racin’, but my legs are all noodley and I can’t really hold my hands straight.
lines.zh: : 我血在涌，心在狂跳，可两条腿软得像面条，手也直不起来。

lines.en: : They’ve got this thing in sports called “The zone” where an athlete just gets like, mega focused for a little while and it kinda, like...enhances all of their abilities and stuff.
lines.zh: : 体育里有个说法叫“进入状态”，就是运动员在一段时间内超级专注，然后……把所有能力都强化之类的。

lines.en: : But I don’t know if this whole...liking you thing has a “zone.”
lines.zh: : 可我不知道“喜欢你”这整件事，有没有所谓的“状态”。

lines.en: : I don’t know when I’m gonna stop being nervous and stuff. Which means I have no idea when I’m gonna be able to go back to normal.
lines.zh: : 我不知道自己什么时候才能不紧张。也就是说，我根本不知道什么时候才能恢复正常。

lines.en: scene mikuwalksatnight14
: Wait! What if it’s not that?! What if I actually am sick?!
lines.zh: : 等等！万一不是因为这个呢？！万一我是真的生病了？！

lines.en: : I’m no doctor, but I’m pretty sure your initial take on the situation is the one you’re looking for.
lines.zh: : 我又不是医生，不过我敢肯定，你最开始的那个判断才是你要找的答案。

lines.en: : Besides, there’s no need to go back to normal. Especially when normal with you has always been kind of abnormal to begin with.
lines.zh: : 再说，也没必要恢复正常。尤其是你所谓的“正常”，从一开始就已经挺不正常的了。

lines.en: scene mikuwalksatnight15
: Ya think so? Cause we’ve got some pretty abnormal girls in our class and I was under the assumption that I was kinda one of the more normal ones.
lines.zh: : 你这么觉得？我们班可有不少相当不正常的女生，我还以为自己算比较正常的那种呢。

lines.en: : Sometimes, sure.
lines.zh: : 有时候吧，确实。

lines.en: : You have your moments, though.
lines.zh: : 不过你也有你的时刻。

lines.en: : Like, I can’t think of anyone else who would have immediately gone against what I asked them to do and told their friend instead of just continuing to make out with me in private.
lines.zh: : 比如说，我想不出还有谁会立刻违背我的要求，转头告诉自己的朋友，而不是继续跟我私下里亲热。

lines.en: scene mikuwalksatnight16
: You mad about that, Sensei? Cause I understand if you are.
lines.zh: : 你生气了吗，Sensei？要是生气我也理解。

lines.en: : Ya gotta remember that you didn’t do anything, though. It was all me. We’d be playin’ a completely different ball game if you made the first move and kissed me instead of me kissin’ you.
lines.zh: : 不过你得记住，你什么都没做。全都是我。要是你先主动吻我，而不是我吻你，那我们现在打的完全是另一场比赛。

lines.en: : That’s true, I guess. I’ve made the first move on several occasions with you before and you never told Makoto about any of those.
lines.zh: : 这么说也对。以前我也主动过你几次，你可从没跟 Makoto 提过任何一次。

lines.en: : Well, until now, I guess.
lines.zh: : 嗯，大概直到现在吧。

lines.en: scene mikuwalksatnight17
: That’s not...completely true...and it might be why I still feel like somethin’s kinda...not right.
lines.zh: : 那也不……完全对……也许这就是为什么我总觉得有什么地方……不太对劲。

lines.en: : Makoto still doesn’t know about what happened at the beach and I kinda...don’t really wanna admit it to her.
lines.zh: : Makoto 还不知道海边发生的事，而我……其实不太想跟她承认。

lines.en: : But that makes me feel really bad cause she told me all about you two goin’ at it.
lines.zh: : 可这让我特别难受，因为她已经把你们俩的事全跟我说了。

lines.en: : I just don’t get why I’d wanna confess one thing but not confess another if they all fit into the same box, ya know?
lines.zh: : 我就是不明白，既然都归在同一个盒子里，我为什么会想坦白一件却不想坦白另一件，你懂吧？

lines.en: : Kissing and dry humping someone to the point of orgasm aren’t really things that fit into the same box, Miku.
lines.zh: : 接吻，和把人干到高潮，可算不上能放进同一个盒子里的事，Miku。

lines.en: : You don’t need a reason to not want to tell a person something. You can just...not want to tell a person something. And that’s completely okay.
lines.zh: : 你不想告诉别人某件事，不需要理由。你可以就是……不想告诉别人。这完全没问题。

lines.en: : But is it still okay when you’re pretendin’ that everything is out in the open even when there’s still somethin’ buried beneath it all?
lines.zh: : 可要是你明明还藏着什么，却装作一切都已经摊开了，那也没问题吗？

lines.en: : Well, let me ask you this- do you think Makoto has really shared everything with you?
lines.zh: : 那我问你一个问题——你觉得 Makoto 真的把一切都告诉你了吗？

lines.en: scene mikuwalksatnight18
: I’m pretty friggin’ sure she has because I have no idea what else two people can even do to each other that she didn’t already tell me about.
lines.zh: : 我他妈相当肯定她说了，因为我想不出两个人之间还能做什么她没跟我讲过的事。

lines.en: : Felt like any moment she was gonna start breakin’ out reference material. Certainly knows where to get it.
lines.zh: : 感觉她随时都能掏出参考资料来。货源她肯定门儿清。

lines.en: : Oh. Well...I don’t know, then.
lines.zh: : 哦。那……我就不知道了。

lines.en: : I’ve never had a best friend to talk to about things like that, so I’m not really sure what someone would be compelled to share or not.
lines.zh: : 我从来没有可以聊这种事的闺蜜，所以不太清楚一个人会被迫分享什么、又不会分享什么。

lines.en: : But I do know that there are things I’d want kept a secret from everyone- and I don’t think you should beat yourself up about it for being in the same boat.
lines.zh: : 但我知道，有些事我是希望对所有人都保密的——所以我觉得你不必因为跟我是同一条船就自责。

lines.en: scene mikuwalksatnight19
: Yeah...probably not...
lines.zh: : 嗯……大概不用吧……

lines.en: : Everythin’ just seems a little too good to be true right now, I guess.
lines.zh: : 只是现在一切都好得有点不真实了，大概。

lines.en: : The guy I like’s hangin’ out with me on a bench in some park and my best friend who likes the same person doesn’t seem to mind at all.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢的人正陪我坐在某个公园的长椅上，而喜欢同一个人的我闺蜜看上去一点都不介意。

lines.en: : I think it’s less that she doesn’t mind and more that she’s just good at dealing with it.
lines.zh: : 我觉得与其说她不介意，不如说她只是很会应付。

lines.en: : Then she’s friggin’ stronger than I’ll ever be cause, if I was in her place, I’d be pissed the heck off.
lines.zh: : 那她可他妈比我强太多了，因为换作是我在她的位置，我早就气炸了。

lines.en: : And what place is that? Because you two don’t seem too far off from where I’m standing.
lines.zh: : 那是什么位置？因为在我看来，你们俩也没差多远。

lines.en: : I mean, she’s basically kinda your girlfriend already, just without the title and...without the kissing.
lines.zh: : 我是说，她基本上已经算是你女朋友了，只是没有那个名分，还有……没有接吻。

lines.en: : You two see each other all the time...she’s super loyal...you’ve done it more times than I can even keep track of...
lines.zh: : 你们俩天天见面……她特别忠诚……你们做的次数我连数都数不清了……

lines.en: : What else is missing?
lines.zh: : 还差什么呢？

lines.en: : Love.
: On my end, at least.
lines.zh: : 至少在我这边是这样。

lines.en: : Well, I hope you change your mind one day.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我希望有一天你会改变主意。

lines.en: : She deserves it.
lines.zh: : 她值得。

lines.en: : And you don’t?
lines.zh: : 你不值得吗？

lines.en: : Not really.
lines.zh: : 不太值得。

lines.en: : I ain’t a bad person, but I ain’t really a good one either.
lines.zh: : 我不是坏人，但也算不上什么好人。

lines.en: : I think you’re a good person, Miku.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你是个好人，Miku。

lines.en: : Sure don’t feel that way, Sensei. Not while I’m pretendin’ to have a totally clean slate when all I did was use my hand to wipe off the dirt.
lines.zh: : 我可不这么觉得，Sensei。尤其在我明明只是用手把脏东西抹掉，却装作自己一干二净的时候。

lines.en: : And, you know what? I don’t really want it to be completely clean either. When stuff like that’s clean, ya gotta take more time to look after it and make sure it doesn’t get all messed up.
lines.zh: : 而且，你知道吗？我也不想它真的干干净净。那种东西一旦干净了，你就得花更多心思去维护，确保它不会被弄糟。

lines.en: : But when somethin’s already a little dirty, you don’t have to be as careful. You can be a little reckless from time to time and just hope that nothin’ goes wrong.
lines.zh: : 可要是它本来就有点脏，你就不必那么小心。你偶尔可以莽撞一点，只盼着别出什么岔子。

lines.en: : Somethin’ always can, though.
lines.zh: : 可岔子总是会有的。

lines.en: : Somethin’ always does.
lines.zh: : 而且总是会出。

lines.en: : This isn’t just about Makoto, is it?
lines.zh: : 这不只是关于 Makoto，对吧？

lines.en: scene mikuwalksatnight20
Miku looks up at me, but doesn’t reply.
lines.zh: Miku 抬头看着我，却没有回答。

lines.en: If she did, she’d be opening herself up. Exposing a weakness.
lines.zh: 如果她开口，就等于敞开了自己，暴露出弱点。

lines.en: And in true athletic fashion, she’s swapped over to defense in order to weather my attack.
lines.zh: 而本着运动员的本能，她切换到了防守，来扛住我的进攻。

lines.en: I’m not much of an athlete, though-
lines.zh: 不过我算不上什么运动员——

lines.en: So it will be a half-hearted attack that I already know she’ll be able to deflect.
lines.zh: 所以这会是一次漫不经心的进攻，而我知道她挡得下来。

lines.en: And one that won’t break through until she’s been worn down to near nothingness.
lines.zh: 而这样的进攻，只有在她被消耗到所剩无几时才会奏效。

lines.en: if kirinkill == False:
: I know what happened to your parents.
lines.zh: : 我知道你父母的事。

lines.en: scene mikuwalksatnight23
: Don’t...
: I can't tell you who told me, but-
lines.zh: : 我不能告诉你是谁说的，但是——
: 不要……

lines.en: : Not yet...
lines.zh: : 还不到时候……

lines.en: : I...ain’t ready...
lines.zh: : 我……还没准备好……

lines.en: : Do you think you ever will be?
lines.zh: : 你觉得你会有准备好的那一天吗？

lines.en: : Sensei...
lines.zh: : Sensei……

lines.en: : I really can’t...
lines.zh: : 我真的做不到……

lines.en: : I won’t force you to.
lines.zh: : 我不会逼你。

lines.en: : I implore you to take your own advice sometime, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我恳请你，哪天也听听自己的建议。

lines.en: : Be a little reckless. Hope that nothing goes wrong.
lines.zh: : 稍微莽撞一点。盼着别出什么岔子。

lines.en: : Maybe even rely on a teammate to make up for the areas you lack in.
lines.zh: : 甚至可以把自己的短板交给队友来补。

lines.en: : I’m not good at sports, but I can listen to whatever it is that happened and give you some half-hearted advice on the matter that’ll likely devolve into some sort of existential monologue.
lines.zh: : 我不擅长运动，但我可以听你说发生过什么，就这件事给你一些半吊子建议——大概最后会变成某种存在主义的独白。

lines.en: : I might be getting ahead of myself in saying this, but I think calling me just another average person in your life is a little outdated at this point.
lines.zh: : 我这么说可能有点操之过急，不过我觉得，再把我当成你生命中又一个普通人，已经有点过时了。

lines.en: : If you want to get closer, get closer. You’re good at that.
lines.zh: : 想跟我更近一点，就更近一点。你很擅长这个。

lines.en: : And remember that simply talking about things that have happened in the past is perhaps the best way to get over them.
lines.zh: : 还有，记住：单纯地把过去发生的事说出来，也许正是走出来的最好方式。

lines.en: Something gets stuck in my throat during that last sentence.
lines.zh: 说到最后一句，有什么东西卡在了我的喉咙里。

lines.en: Probably the irony.
lines.zh: 大概是讽刺吧。

lines.en: else:
: I still don’t know anything about your past.
lines.zh: : 我对你的过去还是一无所知。

lines.en: scene mikuwalksatnight21
: My...past?...
lines.zh: : 我的……过去？……

lines.en: : But...why would you...
lines.zh: : 可是……你为什么……

lines.en: : It just might help me understand a little more about why you think the way you do.
lines.zh: : 这也许能帮我多理解一点，你为什么会这样想。

lines.en: : It’s a bit of a hobby of mine- staring into the depths of people and trying to attach motives to their actions. Particularly the ones that make the least amount of sense to them.
lines.zh: : 这算是我的一点爱好——盯着人内心深处，试图给他们的行为安上动机。尤其是那些对他们自己来说最说不通的行为。

lines.en: : But that’s hard to do when I can’t see even a single quadrant of the big picture.
lines.zh: : 可当我连全局的哪怕一个象限都看不到时，这就很难办了。

lines.en: scene mikuwalksatnight22
: It’s...hard...
: I...start freezing up...
lines.zh: : 我……会开始僵住……

lines.en: : Whenever I...go back there...
lines.zh: : 每次我……回到那里……

lines.en: : That bad?
lines.zh: : 有那么糟吗？

lines.en: scene mikuwalksatnight23
: I can...
lines.zh: : 我还能……

lines.en: : Still hear it...
lines.zh: : 听得见……

lines.en: : See it...
lines.zh: : 看得见……

lines.en: : I don’t...
lines.zh: : 我不……

lines.en: : I...I can’t...
lines.zh: : 我……我做不到……

lines.en: : That’s enough.
lines.zh: : 够了。

lines.en: : You’ll tell me when you’re able to tell me, I guess.
lines.zh: : 等你能说的时候，你自然会告诉我吧。

lines.en: : I just figured that whatever happened back then is probably something I’d know about before we started taking our relationship in a more exciting direction.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得，在我们把关系往更刺激的方向发展之前，当年发生的事我大概总该知道。

lines.en: : I just...
lines.zh: : 我只是……

lines.en: : I want to forget...
lines.zh: : 我想忘掉……

lines.en: : Do you?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？

lines.en: As expected, Miku cocoons herself inside a blanket of fear and waits to metamorphosize into something a little less defenseless.
lines.zh: 不出所料，Miku 把自己裹进恐惧的毯子里，等待蜕变成不那么毫无防备的东西。

lines.en: Something more beautiful.
lines.zh: 某样更美的东西。

lines.en: But her wings fuse to her chrysalis and she gets stuck inside.
lines.zh: 可她的翅膀和她的蛹黏在了一起，她被困在了里面。

lines.en: As such, it falls on me to free her.
lines.zh: 因此，把她解救出来的责任落到了我身上。

lines.en: Or rather-
lines.zh: 或者说——

lines.en: I just want to.
lines.zh: 我只是想这么做。

lines.en: : Let’s just talk about something else.
lines.zh: : 我们换个话题吧。

lines.en: scene mikuwalksatnight24
: Yeah.
: Yeah, that sounds good.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这样挺好。

lines.en: : Sorry for-
lines.zh: : 对不起，我——

lines.en: : Don’t apologize. Just move on.
lines.zh: : 别道歉。往前走就是了。

lines.en: : I’d prefer to not have to drag your screaming, nubile body all the way over to Makoto’s porn sanctuary and have her nurse you back to health.
lines.zh: : 我可不想把你那具尖叫着的、青春诱人的身体一路拖到 Makoto 的色情圣地里，再让她把你护理回健康状态。

lines.en: scene mikuwalksatnight25
: I think there were a bunch’a nicer ways to say that, but...yeah. I don’t really want ya doin’ that either.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这话本可以有一大堆更好听的说法，不过……是啊。我也不想让你那么干。

lines.en: : ‘Sides, bein’ round all those videos makes me feel kinda weird anyway. I’ve got no idea what’s goin’ on in like 90%% of them.
lines.zh: : 再说，待在那一堆视频里我本来就觉得怪怪的。那里头大概有 90%% 我看都不懂在干什么。

lines.en: : Want to find out?
lines.zh: : 想弄明白吗？

lines.en: : Jeez, Sensei. At least take me on a date-
lines.zh: : 天哪，Sensei。至少先带我去约个会——

lines.en: scene mikuwalksatnight26
: Ooh! Right! I was gonna ask ya earlier when we were still with Makoto, but...
lines.zh: : 哦！对了！刚才还跟 Makoto 在一起的时候我就想问你了，不过……

lines.en: : Do you...maybe wanna come to the mall and help me pick out some clothes? I ain’t really sure if that counts as a date or not, but we can call it one if ya want.
lines.zh: : 你……要不要跟我去商场帮我挑几件衣服？我也不确定这算不算约会，不过你要是想，我们就叫它约会好了。

lines.en: : I don’t really care what we call it, but I am interested in helping you find an outfit since that is an area I can now safely say I am slightly experienced in.
lines.zh: : 叫什么我无所谓，但我确实有兴趣帮你挑一身，因为在这方面，我现在可以放心地说自己略有经验了。

lines.en: scene mikuwalksatnight27
: Yeah...I remember you comin’ along with us when we got new swimsuits before the beach trip.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我记得去海边之前我们买新泳衣的时候，你也跟着来了。

lines.en: : I guess this’ll be kinda like that, just...with only us two instead of a group of girls.
lines.zh: : 我想这次大概也差不多，只是……就我们两个，而不是一群女生。

lines.en: : Did you have an idea of when you’d want to go?
lines.zh: : 你想好什么时候去了吗？

lines.en: scene mikuwalksatnight28
: Idunno. Just call me after soccer practice on the weekend and we can meet up at the mall or somethin’.
lines.zh: : 不知道。周末足球训练结束之后给我打个电话，我们在商场碰头什么的。

lines.en: : We can make a whole thing out of it. Somethin’ that’ll get Makoto real jealous when I recap it for her.
lines.zh: : 我们可以把它搞得像模像样。等我跟 Makoto 复盘的时候，准能让她嫉妒得要命。

lines.en: : For my own personal curiosity, is everything we do outside the bedroom in a beach inn something that’s going to be immediately forwarded to Makoto?
lines.zh: : 出于我个人的好奇，我们在海边小旅馆卧室之外做的一切，是不是都会被立刻转播给 Makoto？

lines.en: : Because that would make my life exponentially harder.
lines.zh: : 因为那样的话，我的日子会难上加难。

lines.en: : I can probably make some more exceptions if they’re good enough.
lines.zh: : 要是够精彩的话，我大概可以多破几次例。

lines.en: : Like ya said, I shouldn’t feel inclined to share everything all the time.
lines.zh: : 就像你说的，我不该总觉得什么都必须分享。

lines.en: : You haven’t failed me so far, Sensei. So maybe you’re right about that too.
lines.zh: : 到目前为止你还没让我失望过，Sensei。所以也许这件事你也是对的。

lines.en: : Good enough for me.
lines.zh: : 那我就知足了。

lines.en: : I’ll call you sometime over the weekend, then.
lines.zh: : 那我周末给你打电话。

lines.en: : Sounds good.
: Really lookin’ forward to it.
lines.zh: : 真的很期待。

lines.en: scene black
Seeing as it’s already late and this park is as close to a halfway point as we're going to get, the two of us decide to split up and head back to our respective residences.
lines.zh: 眼看天色已晚，而这个公园已经算是我们能找到的最合适的中点，我们俩决定就此分开，各自回家。

lines.en: There’s no hug or kiss marking the end of the night in a way any different than it would normally be.
lines.zh: 没有拥抱，也没有吻，为这个夜晚画上什么与平时不同的句号。

lines.en: There’s no anything, really.
lines.zh: 其实什么都没有。

lines.en: Just more lingering curiosity about what it is that made Miku Miku-
lines.zh: 只留下更多关于“到底是什么造就了这样的 Miku”的、挥之不去的疑问——

lines.en: And a higher likelihood of her sneaking into my thoughts when I go home to rub one out before bed.
lines.zh: 以及更高的概率：等我回家在睡前解决一发的时候，她会悄悄溜进我的脑海。

$ miku_love += 1
Miku’s affection has increased to [miku_love]!
lines.zh: Miku 的好感度提升到了 [miku_love]！
